policy.implemented: File must exist under PAI/TOOLS and have smoke coverage.
policy.deferred: File may be absent, but every active consumer must declare an unavailable/deferred fallback.
policy.optional: Skill-specific helper; consumers must verify the file before calling it.

Inference.ts.contract: Provider-neutral command adapter. Returns structured unavailable when PAI_INFERENCE_CMD/OPENCODE_INFERENCE_CMD is unset.
smoke: PAI_DIR=$(mktemp -d) bun PAI/TOOLS/Inference.ts --json --level fast system user

ForgeProgress.ts.contract: Codex CLI wrapper with structured unavailable/fail/ok JSON and work-scoped event/final files.
smoke: PAI_DIR=$(mktemp -d) PAI_DISABLE_CODEX=1 bash -lc 'echo prompt | bun PAI/TOOLS/ForgeProgress.ts --slug smoke'

AnvilProgress.ts.contract: Moonshot/Kimi wrapper. Returns structured unavailable when MOONSHOT_API_KEY is absent.
smoke: PAI_DIR=$(mktemp -d) env -u MOONSHOT_API_KEY bash -lc 'echo prompt | bun PAI/TOOLS/AnvilProgress.ts --slug smoke'

CrossVendorAudit.ts.contract: Read-only Codex audit orchestrator. Returns skipped when codex is unavailable or audit infrastructure fails.

Arthur.ts.contract: Deterministic credential-policy narrator. Never emits raw credentials; denies/requires confirmation without explicit policy.

KnowledgeGraph.ts.contract: Read-only graph navigation over MEMORY/KNOWLEDGE frontmatter and wikilinks.

Checkpoint.ts.contract: OpenCode-native ISC checkpoint inspection. Auto-commit is allowlist-only via PAI/checkpoint-repos.txt; rollback prints preview commands and never executes destructive git operations.

SessionHarvester.ts.contract: Mines session transcript JSONL into learning files or review-only KNOWLEDGE/_harvest-queue candidates. Supports --dry-run and explicit --sessions-dir.

KnowledgeHarvester.ts.contract: Maintains MEMORY/KNOWLEDGE with status, validate, index, contradictions, and conservative harvest from review queue/work/research sources.

LearningPatternSynthesis.ts.contract: Aggregates LEARNING/SIGNALS/ratings.jsonl into frustration/success pattern reports. Returns unavailable (no ratings source) or no_data (<5 ratings); supports --week/--month/--all/--dry-run/--json.

RelationshipReflect.ts.contract: Aggregates recent relationship notes + ratings into OPINIONS.md confidence deltas and OUR_STORY milestones. Returns unavailable when sources are absent; supports --opinions-only/--milestones-only/--dry-run/--json.

GenerateTelosSummary.ts.contract: Heuristically compresses USER/TELOS/* into PRINCIPAL_TELOS.md. Returns structured unavailable when core sources (MISSION/GOALS/PROBLEMS) are absent; supports --dry-run.

RemoveBg.ts.contract: Local rembg wrapper (no API). Exits with a clear error when the rembg binary is absent; --help works without it.

MigrateScan.ts.contract: Scans markdown/text into classified migration proposals queued under MEMORY/MIGRATION. Pure; supports --source/--json/--dry-run.

MigrateApprove.ts.contract: Reviews/approves/modifies MigrateScan proposals and routes content into PAI targets with provenance. Pure; --review lists the queue.
